class.name: SteamPresence
class.brief_description: Manages the localized Steam status and optional party grouping for one client scope.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.presence] or [method SteamScope.presence]. Only one attached scope owns the managed status at a time. Replacing or clearing status affects the keys that scope still owns. The Game provider owns the join route independently.

method.name: joinable
method.description: Publishes Steam Join Game for the exact Game's current friends-only or public lobby while admission is open and seats remain. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] if Steam accepted the route or the Game already owns it. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY] when a foreign connect key exists, [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED] for an ineligible or stale lobby, and [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] outside a live Steam Game scope.

method.name: clear_joinable
method.description: Clears this Game's connect key and suppresses automatic publication for the current hosted lobby. Keeps the status label, party grouping, and any foreign connect key. Call [method joinable] to publish again. A newly hosted lobby uses its usual visibility policy. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] outside a live Steam Game scope, or [constant @GlobalScope.FAILED] if Steam declines the clear.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the keys still owned by this scope. A non-owning scope can call this without changing another scope's status. Explicit Friends overrides and unrelated presence keys are preserved. Stopping the owning scope also attempts to clear its keys.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the active main-thread Steam scope supports local status writes and cache reads.

method.name: show
method.description: Publishes a Steamworks localization token beginning with [code]#[/code] and its optional replacements. To group players, provide both a nonempty [param party_id] and a positive [param party_size]. Use the defaults for no grouping. Replacement keys must fit Steam's byte and key limits and must avoid [code]connect[/code], [code]status[/code], and names beginning with [code]steam_[/code]. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY] when another scope owns the status or unrelated keys leave insufficient capacity. Steam applies each key separately. [constant @GlobalScope.OK] acknowledges local acceptance. Configure the token in Steamworks to display the label for other players.
